subject: Hosted evaluation — fast‑path ops preflight & quickstart asks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@finlytics.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finlytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation — fast‑path ops preflight & quickstart asks

Hi Amit / Olivia — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can scope a Hosted pilot that validates latency and cost for your inference pattern.

Key takeaways from the call (my notes):
- Primary UX: user-facing summarization and chat features inside FinLytics web app (avg. user session = 1–3 prompts).
- Expected steady state: ~6 qps peak across business hours, but bursty spikes to ~18 qps for short windows.
- Typical request size: 300–600 tokens in, 150–300 tokens out (chat + context).
- Data controls: you want logs retained 30 days, encryption at rest + in transit, and a SOC 2 letter.
- Deployment preference: start with Hosted API to iterate quickly; consider Dedicated if 99th pct throughput or VPC isolation is required.

To keep momentum, can you confirm these three items by end of week?
1) Pilot target: do you want a standard Hosted sandbox (shared infra) or a temporary higher‑throughput Hosted trial for 7–14 days? (This affects rate cap provisioning.)
2) Peak burst profile: are the 18 qps spikes sustained >5 minutes or short bursts <2 minutes?
3) Procurement / compliance contacts: who should I loop in for SOC 2 / contract questions (name + email)?

Next steps from our side once you confirm:
- Share a short Hosted quickstart checklist (attached) that lists sandbox endpoints, token quotas, and sample client config.
- Provision sandbox endpoints and an elevated trial slot if you pick the higher‑throughput option.
- Share SOC 2 artifact and a mutual action plan (MAP) draft.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf (quick checklist), FL-MAP-v1.xlsx (placeholder MAP we can adapt).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m follow-up if you prefer to walk through the checklist.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Amit Shah <amit@finlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — fast‑path ops preflight & quickstart asks

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap and the checklist. Quick answers below.

1) Pilot target: We'd like to start on Hosted, but we need a short elevated trial (7 days) during our internal load test window next week to validate autoscaling behavior. If Hosted can provide a short burst capacity reservation, that would be ideal.

2) Burst profile: The 18 qps spikes are typically short (30s–2m) but can repeat multiple times per hour during peak. Sustained >5m only during batch testing.

3) Procurement / compliance: Procurement is Olivia Grant (olivia.grant@finlytics.com). Legal is Priya Menon (priya.menon@finlytics.com) — feel free to send SOC 2 and contract drafts to them.

A couple of additional asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the sandbox endpoints and an expected token rate limit for the standard plan vs elevated trial?
- Any guardrails for prefix/KV caching we should implement client-side?

We have a short internal security questionnaire — I can share it after we get the SOC 2 artifact.

Appreciate it,
Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Product, FinLytics
amit@finlytics.com | +1 (617) 555-2301

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@finlytics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finlytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — fast‑path ops preflight & quickstart asks

Thanks Amit — quick answers from the ops side.

Sandbox endpoints / rate caps:
- Sandbox (default): 50 requests/minute per sandbox API key (~0.8 qps sustained) with token soft quota 500k tokens/day. Good for functional validation and basic load tests.
- Elevated Hosted trial (7–14 days): we can provision a temporary slice supporting up to 25 rps sustained with burst headroom to ~60 rps for short windows. We'll coordinate the exact window with you.

Notes / recommendations:
- Because your bursts are short, the elevated Hosted trial is the lowest friction path — no VPC or Dedicated procurement required and we can deactivate after the test.
- Client-side: enable retry with jitter and exponential backoff (we provide a 429 backoff header). Implement client-side prefix caching for repeated context (session templates) — this reduces token spend and improves tail latency.
- KV/prefix caching: safe pattern is to cache embeddings or prompt prefixes for 10–30 minutes; avoid caching user PII. We'll provide config examples in the checklist.

Compliance / SOC 2:
- Kimberly will share SOC 2 Type II report; for the Hosted trial we retain logs for 30 days by default. If you need longer retention we can discuss a custom plan.

Next operational steps I propose:
1) Kimberly to send elevated trial dates (2 options) and the checklist (done).
2) FinLytics confirms a test window and the keys/roles to use.
3) We provision elevated capacity and share sandbox credentials + sample client config.

I attached a short ops playbook (contained inside the quickstart PDF) with endpoint URIs, header patterns, and retry guidance.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0166

Looking forward to the checklist and credentials.

Thanks,
Amit
